notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.notes: BOMBFEST has received a small update for the windows version of the game, fixing bugs related to menu navigation and UI.

notes.title: 1 Week Until Release!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30910250/1cb9af8a29ca5b7399086198f40b20644763f289.png[/img]
[h1]Here It Comes![/h1]
BOMBFEST will be here in 7 days! In the meantime, our team is working our butts off to make sure you get the best game we can offer on launch. We're crushing bugs, scheduling social media, and sleeping occasionally!
[h1]Support The Game![/h1]
Excited to play? Want to help us out? Consider spreading the word and [b]wishlisting us[/b]! Wishlists help us climb the ranks of Steams goofy algorithm, so it means a lot to show your support this way.

notes.title: BOMBFEST 1.01 Update!
notes.notes:
We've got an update for you today, friends! Plenty of bug fixes to improve your experience. Check out the changes below:

[list]
[*] AI may no longer earn achievements for you
[*] Fixed unlocking Ice Bomb twice
[*] Fixed Cotton Swap not OHKOing when players are at max damage
[*] Fixed Setup Menu overlapping itself when first opened
[/list]

Let us know what you think, and good luck with those achievements!
